purpose: Select a current-service guard on a fresh development population, freeze it, then evaluate once on a disjoint fresh holdout population.

selection_rule.eligibility: For every development regime, the mean paired candidate-minus-reactive goodput difference must be >= -0.001 Mbps.
selection_rule.objective: Among eligible candidates, maximize the minimum across development regimes of the mean paired candidate-minus-reactive goodput difference.
selection_rule.tie_break_1: Choose the candidate with the smaller mean paired P95 latency difference across development regimes.
selection_rule.failure_rule: If no candidate is eligible, freeze no candidate and report that the current-service guard family failed the prospective development gate. Do not inspect holdout outcomes for selection.

holdout_rule: Evaluate exactly the frozen development-selected policy and reactive baseline on all holdout seeds and regimes. Do not alter the guard ratio after holdout inspection.
evidence_note: This is a fresh prospective synthetic diagnostic motivated by the development-only high-load mechanism audit. It is not canonical WOMD evidence or final publication inference.
